==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
An expedition goes out to a barren world. The terrain is rocky and gray. Strong dust storms howl through the caverns.

The expedition is in search of two missing people. Everyone is on edge, because there are alien scorpion men on this planet that can eat souls. I am the only one who isn't afraid.

I am a secret shape shifter. I went on the expedition to go consume some scorpion men souls to gain more power. Once I accomplish my goal, I lure the expedition into a trap so that I can take their ship for myself.
